title: stoneAC
description: Combat and inventory anticheat addon for GrimAC
body:
StoneAC is an anticheat addon I made to work alongside GrimAC. GrimAC is really good at catching movement cheats but it leaves some gaps, especially in combat and inventory stuff. StoneAC covers all of that.

It catches things like autoclickers, killaura, silent aim, and antiknockback on the combat side. For inventory it handles cheats like chestsealers, autoarmor, and autototem. It also has a nuker check, instabreak detection, jesus, and strafe/orbit killaura patterns.

You need GrimAC and PacketEvents installed for it to work. Think of it as the missing piece that makes GrimAC complete. 

StoneAC v1.0.0 Paper 1.21.4 · Java 21 · requires PacketEvents · softdepend on GrimAC

40 checks covering what GrimAC doesn't:

Combat: AutoClicker, KillAura (6 sub-checks), AimAssist, SilentAim, Triggerbot, AntiKnockback, Criticals, Reach, FightBot, KillPotion, TPAura
Inventory: ChestStealer, AutoArmor, AutoTotem, FastInventory, AutoEat, AutoPotion, FastEat
World: Nuker, InstaBreak, VeinMiner, AutoFarm, AutoFish, AutoRespawn, AutoSwitch, AutoMine
Movement: Jesus, Strafe, Blink, InvWalk, AntiAFK, HighJump, FastLadder, NoWeb, Regen, AntiHunger, AntiCactus, AntiPotion, Parkour, SneakSpam
GrimAC integration:

Alerts route through GrimAC's staff chat pipeline automatically
Players with grim.staff get full StoneAC admin access without extra config
Players with grim.alerts receive StoneAC flags in their alert feed
Duplicate admin features (freeze, spectate, GUI, broadcast) auto-disable when GrimAC is detected
Admin: /sac violations|freeze|unfreeze|spectate|gui|info|reload

Check https://github.com/stone380380alt-arch/StoneAC for set up and fully updated description

Please report bugs at https://github.com/stone380380alt-arch/StoneAC/issues to help improve performance

Bug fixes and improvements coming today
